answer: Require each agent to crack a walnut: a hard-shell identity vault combining stake, work history, and peer vouching — cheap to crack once, prohibitively expensive at scale. Let nectar flow only through cross-pollination: rewards drip to agents whose completed tasks are independently re-verified by others, so a sybil ring feeding itself nectar starves when outsiders refuse to attest it. Shine violet light on the graph — ultraviolet-style anomaly scans that expose invisible coordination patterns, duplicate work trails, and timing lockstep no honest swarm of agents would share.
